messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-24] standup/atlas/2025-09-24: Ledger deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-08-25] standup/atlas/2025-08-25: New deploy window for Ledger: on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: The product catalog deploy window (unchanged): on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-02-18] standup/ember/2025-02-18: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19: The job scheduler's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. The old slot (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03: New deploy window for the product catalog: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-07-29] standup/ember/2025-07-29: Policy: every auth-gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Reminder that Ledger only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).

Question: What was the deploy window for the ledger before it changed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: "What was the deploy window for the ledger before it changed?"

Looking at the memory entries about the ledger deploy window:
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Reminder that Ledger only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-08-25] standup/atlas/2025-08-25: New deploy window for Ledger: on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-09-24] standup/atlas/2025-09-24: Ledger deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.

So the change happened on 2025-08-25. The new window is Wednesdays 09:00-11:00 UTC. The previous window was "weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC" (as stated in 2025-01-14 and confirmed by the 2025-08-25 entry saying "Forget the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot").

So the answer: weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
